whisper_transcript: Trades. This one military secret is the reason we've sold over 65,000 pairs of work trousers. I'm Connor, founder of True Tailor, and I've spent the last three years obsessing over one question. Why are we still making work gear like it's 1950? Canvas gear is stiff, uncomfortable, and sweaty. Yeah, it was revolutionary then, but 75 years later, how haven't we found something better? Well, turns out we have, but no one is telling anyone. Modern military and outdoor gear uses ripstop nylon with reinforced stitching. It's literally four times more flexible than canvas, three times more breathable, and completely waterproof. But somehow work pants are still made from the same shit your great-grandfather wore. Canvas is thick because it has to be. It's weak fabric trying to be tough. Modern fabrics are bomb-proof at half the weight. Here's what nobody tells you. Tough doesn't mean bulky. Tough means engineered. This fabric can handle anything you throw at it, but moves like athletic wear. Canvas can't do both, hell. Canvas can barely do one, so we built work pants with actual 21st-century fabric. Every pair has been torture-tested by real tradesmen. And to celebrate our second birthday, we're running a buy one, get one free sale right now, but with limited stock only. We're that confident we've got the best work trouser out there that we offer a 30-day wear and return guarantee. Don't like them? Send them back. It's 2025. Stop dressing like it's the Great Depression and upgrade to True Tailor today.

Title: Serious Failures in Service, Delivery, and Consumer Rights Compliance

My experience with True Tailor has been profoundly unsatisfactory and raises significant concerns about the company’s operational standards and commitment to basic consumer rights.

I ordered two pairs of trousers based on assurances of quality and professionalism. Instead, the order was sent to an entirely incorrect address, and despite immediate notification, True Tailor refused to take the necessary steps to correct their own error. The courier confirmed that only the sender could amend the delivery details, yet the company declined to act, demonstrating a clear unwillingness to resolve an issue of their own making.

When the items eventually reached me, both pairs were ill‑fitting, falling far short of the company’s claims regarding accurate tailoring and quality control.

Since then, I have made repeated attempts to contact True Tailor to arrange a lawful return and refund. Every email has been ignored. This complete lack of engagement is unacceptable and suggests a disregard for customer obligations and statutory responsibilities.

True Tailor’s conduct reflects systemic failures in customer service, accountability, and product reliability. Their refusal to address legitimate concerns or even acknowledge correspondence is deeply concerning. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this company and strongly caution others to consider these issues before placing an order.
WARNING. They do NOT honor their return policy.  Would not refund me for an unopened item.  Order #63647  FYI, they operate out of England - not the USA.

Absolutely dreadful experience from start to finish.

The delivery took far longer than expected, communication was poor, and when the product finally arrived the quality was shockingly bad. The item looks and feels extremely cheap, with very poor finishing and no real quality control. It is nowhere near the standard shown in the photos or description.

I work in a professional trade environment and this is simply not something you could seriously use or recommend to anyone expecting decent equipment.

Honestly, based on the quality I received, I genuinely struggle to understand the positive reviews that are online because the product I received was nowhere near the standard those reviews describe.

The whole experience has been frustrating and disappointing, and I am now trying to return the item and get a full refund.

I would strongly advise people to think carefully before ordering from this company.

The products are very poorly made the zipper barely worked to unzip to try on out of the package. So I emailed asking for the return address and refund. Their return options are a scam exchange or one item from your purchase ordered 5 items keep the products and receive a 30% refund or send them back and have store credit. None of those options were acceptable so I asked for the return address again. This was shipped out of TX USA they want you to return it to the United Kingdom at a base rate or 45$ so they want me to take a bath for their piss poor quality. I will go out of my way to recommend everyone I know in the trades looking for good gear to stay far away from this scam. Should be able to give 0 stars for this kinda nonsense

I advised I had sent a picture already and I did not have the packaging any more (obviously!).They refused to accept any return. As such, they have lost my business forever, and I certainly won't buy 2 more. They are worn once a week, so maximum worn 8 times.
Order process was decent, and the product seems good but I’ve only had them for a week. The trousers are comfortable to wear.

What can I say, its been 5 days of wearing my new trousers, and the are exactly as described, they are extremely comfortable, I do recommend size up, i did get a Medium and large just to see. Large is perfect for work and the Medium will be perfect just for walks etc. So I'm very happy on both sizes.

Only one suggestion is to have a a zip back pocket for the old wallet, apart from that I will not buy any other from now on.

Why oh why didn't I read more reviews?! I was desperate for some new work trousers and I was going round in circles trying to decide what to get. Unfortunately I chose True Tailor. 
I was enticed by the "completely risk free" tagline and I went for the 2 pairs option. The website suggested "sizing up" and as I have been a 32-34 for many years and have recently lost weight, I went for the 34L. Unfortunately the "L" doesn't stand for long (it stands for large) and goodness knows what planet they're on to even suggest that what I got could be called a 34... I've now got trousers that don't even come close to doing up, the legs are skin tight like leggings and they stop at my ankles! My wife thought it was hilarious... I had to chuckle, especially as I thought they could just be sent back for a full refund. Oh no, after nearly a week of trying, I finally received a reply offering me 1) a replacement, 2) a 30% refund but keep the trousers or 3) store credit. What the actual.....?! 
A replacement is no good because even their XXXL won't be long enough. 30% refund but keep the useless trousers? No thanks. Store credit? No! Again, none of they're trousers would fit me. 
My advice would be to completely avoid this company!

The trousers are really good, fit well and are comfortable enough that I have already set one pair aside for non work use. Next set will also include some fleece lined for the next winter season. Love them keep it up!

Avoid avoid avoid!! Took ages to recite items. Poor customer service! The zip keeps sliding down and a stitching came undone leaving a hole. Contacted customer service and explained this showing a photo but they said it’s gone past the 30 day return. Absolute joke of a company!

My only reservations are if a hot suppressor will melt them, I guess I will have to find out the hard way

So far so good, Im a builder whos worn the same type of work pants for decades and decided to try something a bit different. Thought i would miss the pouch pockets but havent so far, extreamly comfortable time will tell if hard wearing.

Very comfortable, good fit and appears to do what they say on the ad so far. In chilly conditions nice and warm, in warmer conditions not over hot!how do they do that?
Very happy with my purchase, well done True Taylor.
Rubbish quality, no real way to contact the company. Takes forever for delivery. Not willing to accept returns. Dont waste your money.

These are no way indestructible, do not waste your money.
These are good fit and stretchy.  They look smart which is ideal as I am a manger but need to be hands on occasionally so they fulfil both functions.
Fairly prompt delivery of my order . Trousers are comfy and lightweight . Not tried in rain yet

DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS JOKE OF A COMPANY!!! THEIR WEBPAGE IS TRASH JUST LIKE THEIR NOT WATERPROOF, GARBAGE PANTS!!! DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY LIKE I DID!!!

Don,t buy from them they appear to be based in China. If you try to return items they will offer you the following. (Cut and pasted from their email)
1) Free exchange (most popular option)
We’d be happy to send a replacement at no extra cost (same item in a different size or colour). You’ll just need to return the original item to us (at your own expense). As soon as we receive it, we’ll get your exchange confirmed and on its way. Simply let us know the size/colour you’d like.
 
2) Partial refund
If you’d prefer not to bother with returning your order, we can refund 30% of your purchase and you keep the item. No returns needed, just a quick and easy option.

There is no return address on the website and they ignore the fact you want a refund.
Decent pants arrived in reasonable time great customer service and all at an affordable price what more do you want?

All in all, I'm very happy

Poor poor poor.

Stay away and stick to snickers- Dewalt- much better products with better returns policy.

The pockets are all small, you can't get your hand in or out of the pockets and the inside of the pocket would not last long with screws in them. The two phone pocket is small and on the front where it will get damaged. No pockets will take screw drivers or work tools.

The trousers are tight with no knee pad protestion.
Really confutable , just need more pockets and something where I can hook a tape measure on

Where do I start! Do not order from this company. Unless you want substandard goods, extremely poor delivery times, diabolical customer service. Having to jump through hoops to get a refund which I am still waiting on an order placed the 10th of January 2026. After firing back emails like a semi-automatic gun I have been left with serious doubts in me actually getting my money back. Avoid at all cost it simply isn't worth the hassle!!!

Both trousers meant to be the same size I think one pair were child size
Real issues trying to get them swapped

I placed an order just over two weeks ago worth around £350 and have still received no meaningful update or delivery.

Since ordering, I’ve received two rather vague emails. The first said my order was being packed and may already have shipped, and the second—sent a few days later—stated that “some orders” were experiencing delays. Neither email included my order number, which suggests they were generic automated messages rather than genuine updates about my order.

This gives the impression that the company may be using automated communications to buy time, which is unfortunately common with drop-shipping businesses that present themselves as UK-based but ship from overseas.

I also contacted customer services and received an automated reply stating I would be contacted within 48 hours. It has now been well over that timeframe and I have still received no response at all.

At this point I have no order update, no response from customer service, and no indication of when or if the order will arrive. If I don’t hear anything by tomorrow, I will be contacting my credit card company to request a chargeback/refund.

Very disappointing experience so far.

Absolutely poor service , 3 weeks to deliver , the 1st pair the zip broke on the 3rd day , 2nd pair the stitching ripped on the pocket on the 1st day , it’s taken another 3 weeks dealing with customer services,they refused a refund because they had be worn !!!! Currently awaiting replacement pairs to be sent out , but various email requesting pictures of damage and pictures of labels etc , all just delaying tactics,  personally I think it’s all a SCAM

Ordered 3 pairs of pants. Although some reviews said the delivery from China took a long time as I was in no rush to receive them so made the order. Delivery was less than 10 days. Comfort and fit was very good. Worn and washed a few times. Up to now I am really happy with the purchase and would order more. Even saved one pair that I use for walking. Genuine review from a renovator. How they will wear remains to be seen.

Zero stars would be more accurate.
These trousers are the opposite of the advertisement.
They fall down just enough so you can’t lift your leg up, not waterproof, they tear easily and shipped from China. These are on Temu and rightly so cheaper.

Waste of money.

The trousers broke the first time I wore them. These things happen sometimes but the customer service was horrendous. I still have a broken pair of trousers, no replacements no refund. I have reported this company to trading standard. Avoid this terrible company.

DO NOT ORDER !
Everything seemed fine at first from looking at the website. In hindsight I should’ve checked the reviews here first. 
This is clearly a dropshipping scam that is disguised as well made, high quality clothing and fast delivery.
The items get shipped to their warehouse from China so you will have to wait a long time for your order. The items do not match the description or the images whatsoever. The quality is terrible, will not last long until things fall apart and rip. 
When I emailed them about how long the order was taking to even get dispatched they said it was because “it’s a busy period” this is a straight up lie it’s because it’s getting flown in from the other side of the planet.
Ordered 2 months ago and still nothing.

These trousers appear to be well made. I've worn them for a week and they just keep getting more comfortable; they were slightly stiff at first. They are a close fit for me, I have wide thighs, and the waist and length are true.  Pockets are good. Nice depth. Two zipped pockets on front thighs good for mobile phone, but zip opening is on just wide enough to get my hand in. Delivered in good time. Very satisfied so far. Will see how they are wearing in a few months.
I’ve only had the trousers a short time but so far so good. They’re comfortable and very flexible when I’m working on my allotment plot.
THIS IS A DROPPING-SHIPPING SITE, YOU CAN BUY THE EXACT SAME THIS ON TEMU FOR A 1/4 OF THE PRICE. JUST SEARCH MENS WORK TROUSERS.
AVOID! Having to get my bank to intervene due to no answers from customer service and no order!!

Two stars because I actually received something for my money. That’s unfortunately where the good news finishes.

I bought two pairs of trousers with their ‘Buy one get one free offer’ which seems to be constantly available despite the anxiety inducing ‘24-hour-only’ countdown on the website.

It’s taken a month to the day to receive the goods. The website states True Tailor are a UK-based company, shipping with Royal Mail and delivering their products within approx a week of ordering. Do not believe this nonsense. It is a fabrication to try and align themselves with actual high-quality companies; of which True Tailor definitely are not. 

After waiting weeks and weeks and getting frustrated with the non-existent customer service, I decided to do a little deep dive on the company.

Given the name of the company, you’d be forgiven for thinking this is a legit business that’s put hundreds of hours into R&D, improving the product with each bit of feedback and selling something that will truly stand the test of time - or at least the work site, as they claim.

The reality is quite the opposite. This ‘business’ is a 20-something year old kid who dropships below-par clothing from China. I’m sorry but that is it. Do your own digging on Companies House and it’s all there in black and white, along with other similar businesses that, I presume, are just as low quality and disappointing.

I opened one pair of trousers after getting home from my workshop, and you can instantly tell the poor quality from a mile off. The trousers are super thin, the stitching is frayed and all over the place. The sizing is way off - I bought a large (usually a 34W) and these are super tight. 

There is no branding on them at all, just some generic Chinese name on the button. Even if these did fit I would not be bothering to try them. I’ve got plenty of high-quality walking and work trousers (Dewalt, Scruffs, Mountain Equipment, Revolution Race, Rab etc) which do all have a price attached, but for good reason.

The quality is absolutely night and day. PLEASE don’t waste your time or money. I’m sure this drop shipping business will make the owner a bit of money while it lasts, until the reviews catch up with him. 

Buy something decent from a reputable company!
Brilliant trousers and super quick delivery

I bought  more of the next size up for a looser fit, I also bought the fleece lined trousers, which again, worked well whilst working outside in inclement weather. I have now bought the jackets. All great, delivery, packaging, products, good belt, great trousers, a touch long in the legs for me ( shortass) but otherwise a great fit, very warm with the fleece lining.

I’m not even sure Olivia from customer service is human, her responses are vague and not specific to your order (she was absolutely no help when I was trying to find out there the was when it hasn’t been delivered). I work for an online retailer so I know that it is possible to tell customers where there order is (import contains, warehouse, loaded onto van, courier depot, delivery van, or even lost!!) so to palm a customer off with vague delivery timeframes about general orders is just not acceptable. 
Additionally, I placed an order in 2024 and not only had those trousers lasted this whole time, the quality is better and the fit is better than this latest order. 
So if you do plan to order again, so expect the exact same products
Considering everything - very late delivery, faulty item them refusing to replace and downhill quality- I will not be ordering again and I would advise you not to either.
